headline: Revenue grows but margins and earnings slip on cost pressure
summary_short: HP's fourth-quarter revenue rose 9.3% to $16.0B, but non-GAAP EPS fell 10.8% to $0.83 and non-GAAP operating margin dropped 180bp to 6.2%. FY27 non-GAAP EPS is guided to $3.15-$3.45.
summary_long: Q4 net revenue was $16.0B (+9.3%, +8.6% constant currency). Non-GAAP EPS of $0.83 beat the $0.69-$0.79 outlook but included a $0.15 tariff refund benefit. Free cash flow was $0.80B versus $1.49B a year ago. For FY26, revenue was $60.5B (+9.5%) and non-GAAP EPS $3.33. The quarterly dividend rises to $0.31. Q1 FY27 non-GAAP EPS outlook is $0.66-$0.76.
confidence_notes: Period label mismatch: the shard labels this event FY2026 Q3, but the release is HP's fiscal Q4 and full-year FY2026 (period ended Oct. 31, 2026); figures come from the release. EPS includes a $0.15 favorable tariff refund effect in Q4. From Q1 FY27 HP will exclude stock-based compensation from non-GAAP measures, so FY27 guidance is on a changed basis.

drivers.explanation: Growth in higher-value businesses, with AI PCs reaching nearly 60% of shipments; Printing revenue was down 1% y/y.
Management cites memory and storage cost pressures and a challenging environment; its FY27 outlook reflects continued cost and demand pressures.
Operating cash flow fell to $0.93B from $1.62B a year earlier. The release does not explain the swing.
